title: I Surrender
lyrics_original: Lord as You draw me near
I know You hear my cry
Lord have Your way in me
Lord have Your way in me
Lord have Your way in me
Lord have Your way in me
Lord have Your way in me
Lord have Your way in me
Lord have Your way in me

bible_verses.telugu: దేవునియొద్దకు రండి, అప్పుడాయన మీయొద్దకు వచ్చును, పాపులారా, మీ చేతులను శుభ్రముచేసికొనుడి; ద్విమనస్కులారా, మీ హృదయములను పరిశుద్ధపరచుకొనుడి.
bible_verses.english: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

bible_verses.telugu: కాబట్టి సహోదరులారా, పరిశుద్ధమును దేవునికి అనుకూలమునైన సజీవ యాగముగా మీ శరీరములను ఆయనకు సమర్పించుకొనుడని దేవుని వాత్సల్యమునుబట్టి మిమ్మును బతిమాలుకొనుచున్నాను. ఇట్టి సేవ మీకు యుక్త మైనది.
bible_verses.english: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.

bible_verses.telugu: నీ తట్టు నా చేతులు చాపుచున్నాను ఎండిపోయిన భూమివలె నా ప్రాణము నీకొరకు ఆశ పడుచున్నది.
bible_verses.english: I spread out my hands to you; I thirst for you like a parched land.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, here I am before You, laying down my pride, my fears, and my desire to control everything. I am truly desperate for Your presence and long to draw near to Your heart. Take all that I am and renew my spirit as I yield my whole life to You today. Help me to rest in Your deep love and trust Your perfect plans for me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, here I am before You, laying down my pride, my fears, and my desire to control everything. I am truly desperate for Your presence and long to draw near to Your heart. Take all that I am and renew my spirit as I yield my whole life to You today. Help me to rest in Your deep love and trust Your perfect plans for me. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: True surrender begins when we stop striving and simply bow our hearts before the Lord. When we fall to our knees in honest desperation, God doesn't turn us away; instead, He draws gently near to us. Yielding our entire lives to Jesus isn't a loss of control, but a step into His complete grace and peace. As you sing today, lay down every burden and trust that He holds your heart securely.
